description: Defines a Flutter widget named BoardTile, representing an animated, interactive square tile for a Tic Tac Toe game board, showing X or O with visual effects and tap animations.

classes.name: BoardTile
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays a game tile with animated tap feedback, showing X or O, with styling for highlighting and enabled/disabled states.

classes.name: _BoardTileState
classes.description: State class for BoardTile, managing animation controllers and handling gesture interactions for scale animation on tap.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the BoardTile widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes animation controller and scale tween for tap feedback.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of animation controller to free resources.

methods.name: _handleTapDown
methods.description: Handles tap down event, starting the scale animation if enabled.

methods.name: _handleTapCancel
methods.description: Handles tap cancel event, reverting the scale animation.

methods.name: _handleTapUp
methods.description: Handles tap up event, reverting the scale animation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the animated widget tree for the tile, applying styles, gesture detectors, and animations.
